exceptions.reason: braces: no patched release exists (every version up to the latest, 3.0.3, is affected). It is a stack-exhaustion denial of service from deeply nested brace patterns, so it needs an attacker-chosen pattern. In the root package it is reached through globby, which src/ only calls with fixed literal patterns such as **/*.csproj, and through pm2's file watcher, which nothing here turns on. In extension it is reached only through @vscode/vsce, a devDependency that packages the extension. Re-check when braces publishes a fix.

http-cache-semantics: no patched release exists. It is reached only through electron-builder, a devDependency of desktop (got, cacheable-request, http-cache-semantics, while downloading build tooling), so none of it ships in the app. The disclosure needs a shared HTTP cache serving several users, which a build machine's download cache is not. Re-check when http-cache-semantics publishes a fix.
